item.title: Exploring the Intersection of Creativity and Critical Thinking Among Students: A Meta-Analysis
item.description: What it’s about In this paper, we examine how strongly creativity and critical thinking are associated across student populations. Abstract This meta-analysis synthesizes evidence on the relationship between creativity and critical thinking among students. It quantifies the overall association and examines heterogeneity across studies, with implications for educational assessment and interventions targeting 21st-century skills.
